title: What Happens If You Stop Paying a $20,000 Mortgage?

scenes.text: What if you halt a $20,000 mortgage payment tomorrow?

scenes.label: GRACE PERIOD
scenes.text: Many lenders give a 15‑day grace before late fees apply.

scenes.label: CREDIT IMPACT
scenes.text: A single missed payment can drop your credit score by 30‑50 points.
scenes.query: credit score drop missed mortgage payment

scenes.label: REPO RISK
scenes.text: After 90 days of non‑payment, the lender can start foreclosure proceedings.
Follow if you're done staying broke.
